resources.string: A free, ad-free, offline medication reminder. Your data never leaves this phone.
Without these, your medication alarms may not fire. We will walk you through them — you can change any of them later in Settings.

MedAlarm is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. You are responsible for taking your medication correctly. Notifications may be delayed or missed due to Android battery management; do not rely on this app alone for life-critical medication.

MedAlarm is a free, open-source app written to help people take their medication on time. It is a social responsibility project. There are no ads in this app. No personal data is collected or transmitted to any server. No internet connection is required. Your data is stored only on your phone.

MedAlarm is not a medical device. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. This app is only a reminder tool. All responsibility for your medication lies with you:

• Right medication, right dose, right time — you are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter.
• Your doctor's instructions always take priority. This app does not replace your doctor.
• Notifications may not arrive. Android battery management, manufacturer optimizations, the phone being off, or the app being killed by the system can cause notifications to be delayed or missed entirely. Do not use this app as your only safety net.
• Use a backup reminder for critical medications. For life-critical medications, do not rely on this app alone.
• Consult your doctor for health concerns.

The developer cannot be held liable in any way for health issues, losses, or damages arising from missed or delayed notifications, or from data loss.

By using MedAlarm, you accept these terms.
